On such a celebratory holiday, of course we have to shoot a big load into—wait, I mean, fire a grand salute for the cute little kid! How should we properly educate kids? It must be through a mother's hands-on leading by example! So for this issue, we've invited special guest Mama Aponia to join little Griseo for a beautiful full day. From morning 'til night, they'll spend an "ed-lewd-cational" and "over-flowing-ly" meaningful Children's Day together (●'◡'●)
